templates.what: Destroy an owner (project, group, ...) and delete its upload records
templates.writes: main: owner row; database of uploads: uploads
templates.constraint: uploads(model_type, model_id) references the owner

templates.what: Create a user and synchronize the traversal_ids of its personal namespace
templates.writes: users; namespaces.traversal_ids
templates.constraint: traversal_ids is the sequence of ancestor ids along parent_id plus the own id; the namespace references the user

templates.what: Create a group and its route
templates.writes: namespaces; routes, redirect_routes
templates.constraint: routes.source_id references the group; routes.path is the path of the parent group plus the path of the group

templates.what: Create a user and its membership on invitation
templates.writes: users, user_details, user_preferences, emails, identities; members
templates.constraint: user_details, user_preferences, emails, identities and members reference users

templates.what: Create an organization and its owner
templates.writes: organizations; organization_users and others
templates.constraint: organization_users references organizations and users

templates.what: Create a project and its route
templates.writes: projects; routes, redirect_routes
templates.constraint: routes.source_id references the project; routes.path is the path of the namespace plus the path of the project

templates.what: Delete the old upload record and write the new one
templates.writes: uploads
templates.constraint: uploads references the owner; at most one record per path

templates.what: Write the verification state of an upload
templates.writes: uploads; upload_states
templates.constraint: upload_states.upload_id references uploads

templates.what: Write the verification state of a partitioned upload table
templates.writes: partitioned upload table; its state table
templates.constraint: the state row references the upload row

templates.what: Create a security policy bot user and add it as a project member
templates.writes: users; members, notification_settings, events, projects
templates.constraint: members, notification_settings and events reference users and the project

templates.what: Deactivate a SCIM identity and remove its group access
templates.writes: identities; members
templates.constraint: the membership depends on a valid SCIM identity

templates.what: Recompute the two-factor requirement of a user when its memberships change
templates.writes: members; users, user_details, user_preferences
templates.constraint: users.require_two_factor_authentication_from_group is the disjunction of the two-factor requirements of the groups of the user; the grace period is their minimum

templates.what: Transfer a group, rewriting the full route paths of the group and all its descendants
templates.writes: namespaces.parent_id; routes, redirect_routes
templates.constraint: the routes.path of every descendant is the concatenation of the paths of its ancestors

templates.what: Transfer a project, rewriting its full route path
templates.writes: projects.namespace_id; routes, redirect_routes
templates.constraint: routes.path is the path of the namespace plus the path of the project

templates.what: Modify the notification settings and the notification email together
templates.writes: notification_settings; users, user_details
templates.constraint: no constraint relates the two sides
